notes: Bare «عبد الله» in the text; the fuller name a source gives is not in the text and is not used (rule 9).
«سألت الحسن» names al-Hasan as the source of the ruling (rule 5).

fixes.reason: K6I attaches Abdullah ibn Umar (d. 74 AH in name_facts) to a bare «عبد الله» who narrates from Yazid ibn Zurayʿ (d. 182 AH), which the chain order cannot allow.

evidence.quote: أنبأنا عبد الله، عن يزيد بن زريع
عبد الله بن عمر بن الخطاب
